The Solstice mark (Eeva V1 board 2), taken from the full logo: filled, in the current text colour. The ThinkingBlock shows it in the accent and turning while streaming, in ink and still when done.

**Use:** The agent's presence in the ThinkingBlock.

**Avoid:** Not a logo lockup; that is the brand asset, not an icon.

**Variants:** spinning

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `number` | no | 16 in the ThinkingBlock. |
| `spinning` | `boolean` | no | Turns slowly and evenly in its own plane while the agent streams (motion.spin); still when done. |
| `className` | `string` | no |  |

Hand-written card: the repository has no story for the mark.
